summary: iter-34 Findings Snapshots feature validated end-to-end (backend + frontend). 10/10 pytest unit tests PASS in test_findings_snapshots.py (list, detail+diff, PDF export, email send, diff helper). LIVE backend e2e confirmed: GET /findings-snapshots returns ordered snapshots with fresh_files_since_last_run; GET /findings-snapshots/{sid} returns findings array + diff (new/resolved/unchanged); GET .../pdf returns HTTP 200 application/pdf with valid %PDF- header and content-disposition 'Findings_Backfill_Test_Co_<date>.pdf'; POST .../email returns 200 sent=1 to mira@workz.example.com. Frontend Playwright e2e (buyer alex on 'Backfill Test Co' room, route /app/rooms/{rid}) confirmed: tab-findings click reveals findings-snapshot-picker (7 options, first labelled 'Latest · DATE · 5 findings'), findings-export-pdf button downloads PDF via XHR (200/application/pdf) with sonner success toast, findings-email opens email-findings-modal with recipients input + note textarea + Cancel + Send PDF, submission POST returns 200 and modal closes + clears, switching snapshots in the dropdown rerenders findings list and recomputes findings-diff-badge (e.g. 'vs prior: +5 new'). Executive-summary card, severity-breakdown pills (3 HIGH / 2 MEDIUM / 0 LOW), 5 finding-citation-open-{id} chips, and PdfPreview deep-link all render correctly after a fresh /generate-findings run. The async findings job pattern (POST /deal-rooms/{rid}/generate-findings → poll GET /deal-rooms/{rid}/findings-job/{jid}) completes in <2.5s on this 8-file room and stamps job_id on every finding doc.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy findings rows (pre iter-34) on production-like vaults have no job_id stamp, so opening any of the 6 legacy snapshots in 'Backfill Test Co' shows '0 high / 0 medium / 0 low' + empty findings list under the picker — visually confusing because the picker label still says 'N findings' (it counts from findings_jobs.findings_count, while the body filters deal_room_findings by job_id). Not a regression — new runs work correctly — but consider a one-time backfill migration that stamps the most recent prior job_id onto unstamped findings (or hides legacy snapshots whose findings cannot be resolved) so historical entries in the dropdown don't render as empty.

Old findings_jobs rows also lack severity_breakdown + executive_summary; the UI falls back to '0/0/0' pills gracefully but the Executive-summary card silently hides — same migration could backfill these from the findings docs to keep the dropdown experience consistent.

Empty/preview vaults (status='preview') do not surface the Findings tab content path at all for the buyer in our test — couldn't validate the 'no snapshots → Generate findings button' path on a preview vault. This appears to be NDA/state-gated. Confirmed via code review of DealRoomDetail.jsx lines 788-965 that snapshots.length===0 branch renders the Generate button (works in unit/mocked tests); main agent can verify visually on a fresh NDA-signed empty vault.
